name: ngXpress
description: Build production-ready Angular apps with ngXpress — a full-stack starter kit powered by Angular 22 +  SSR, Express 5, Prisma 7, Tailwind CSS, spartan/ui and Better Auth for seamless authentication.

paragraphs: ngXpress is an Angular full-stack starter: one process, server-side rendering, a real API, and auth that ships. This is a production-oriented Angular 22 + Express 5 boilerplate with out-of-the-box SSR, zoneless execution, Prisma 7 (PostgreSQL by default; any database Prisma supports), Better Auth, spartan/ui (Helm + Brain — the shadcn-style kit for Angular), Tailwind CSS 4, and Signal Forms. Feature-first on both the UI and the API — clone it, rebrand it, ship it.

This is the first tagged baseline of ngXpress on the current stack. If you used the earlier Angular 20 / SQLite / npm template, see Upgrading from the Angular 20 template — treat this as a new start, not a drop-in merge.
features: Angular 22 — standalone components, signals, native control flow (@if / @for), zoneless by default
SSR in one process — @angular/ssr + Express 5; no separate frontend/backend servers
Better Auth — email/password, session cookies, password reset, SSR session via TransferState

Prisma 7 — PostgreSQL is the default (@prisma/adapter-pg). Swap the datasource, adapter, DATABASEURL, and Better Auth provider for any database Prisma supports (MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server, CockroachDB, MongoDB, and…
spartan/ui — accessible Helm components (Brain primitives + Tailwind) in src/app/shared/ui

requirements.text: Signal Forms — @angular/forms/signals on login, signup, and task dialogs
Authentication — sign in, sign up, forgot/reset password
